The team competes in the [[Erovnuli Liga]], the first tier of the national [[Football in Georgia (country)|football league system]]. Being the all-time second most successful Georgian club, Torpedo have been a regular member of the top division apart from three seasons in the late 2000s. They have won the national league four times, the [[Georgian Cup]] five times and the [[Georgian Super Cup|Super Cup]] three times. Torpedo play their home games at the [[Ramaz Shengelia Stadium]], known until 2015 as the Givi Kiladze stadium."}}
